responsibility: Defines the x86 AVXVNNI intrinsic interface for 128-bit and 256-bit neural-network integer dot-product operations using AVX-width vectors. It provides wrappers for dpbusd, dpbusds, dpwssd, and dpwssds AVX forms, acting as the public API for the AVXVNNI extension and separating these AVX-based operations from both AVX512VNNI and AVXVNNIINT8-specific headers.
